cases.v-future: the same goal stated in future francs: the nominal figures of 1.3.0, and a real view beside them
cases.v-indexed: the same goal stated in today's francs with the contribution indexed: the real required return is the one of the problem without inflation
cases.v-not-realistic: 125'000 in future francs in 1.25 years from 100'000 and 4'000 a year: about 15 % a year, feasible and not realistic, with the levers
cases.v-retirement: a need of 60'000 a year in today's francs against AHV and a nominal BVG pension, compared in today's francs
cases.v-worked-example: the design note's worked example: CHF 400'000 in today's francs (not stated, decision 7) in 20 years, 150'000 now, 12'000 a year fixed; under 1.4.0 at the calibrated CHF inflation

changes_by.amounts_in_todays_francs: a goal amount in today's francs unless stated (decision 7), inflated to its date, and a contribution fixed or indexed (decision 9): the mandate's target, required return, curve and notes in francs of the target date (LBS-31)
changes_by.plausibility: the plausibility judgement of the required return (LBS-34), new
changes_by.real_view: the real view and the basis of each figure, new and additive (LBS-31, LBS-35)
changes_by.retirement_in_todays_francs: the retirement comparison in today's francs: the need read in today's francs and the nominal BVG pension deflated from its first year (LBS-33)

tolerance: 1e-9 relative on every number (absolute near zero), every other leaf exactly
